summary: Model quantities varying across space and time and identify what makes a physical problem fully specified.
outcomes: Derive a simple conservation equation from a balance law
Distinguish initial conditions from boundary conditions and well-posedness questions
sequence: Track flux into and out of a short spatial interval
Introduce gradient, divergence and the Laplacian locally
Compare heat, wave and Poisson equations
Choose Dirichlet or Neumann conditions from the physical story
Check uniqueness or compatibility on a small example

visual.question: How does changing the boundary affect the entire solution?
visual.interaction: Switch fixed-value and fixed-flux boundaries while tracking a conserved quantity

practice.task: Formulate a one-dimensional diffusion problem completely
practice.success: Equation, units, domain, initial state and boundary conditions are mutually consistent
